note: Public datasets the dashboard can download into Universe/data/. serve.ps1 downloads them; universe-ui.mjs parses them into the searchable universe. Edit this file to add series, managers, or years.

datasets.name: FRED: US interest rates and yield curve
datasets.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
datasets.license: Public data; cite FRED and the original source.
datasets.description: Fed funds rate, 2- and 10-year Treasury yields, the 10y-2y curve, 30-year mortgage rate and the US high-yield spread.

series.title: US high-yield bond spread (ICE BofA OAS)

datasets.name: FRED: US inflation, jobs and recessions
datasets.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
datasets.license: Public data; cite FRED and the original source (BLS, BEA, NBER).
datasets.description: CPI and core CPI, core PCE prices, unemployment rate, nonfarm payrolls and the NBER recession indicator.

series.title: US core CPI, ex food and energy (index)

datasets.name: FRED: US growth, consumers and housing
datasets.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
datasets.license: Public data; cite FRED and the original source.
datasets.description: Real GDP, industrial production, consumer sentiment, retail sales and housing starts.

datasets.name: FRED: equity indexes, dollar, euro and oil
datasets.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
datasets.license: Public data; S&P 500 history on FRED covers only about the last 10 years.
datasets.description: S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite levels, the broad trade-weighted dollar, USD per euro and WTI crude oil.

datasets.name: FRED: India rupee, inflation and rates
datasets.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), from the Fed, OECD and IMF
datasets.license: Public data; cite FRED and the original source.
datasets.description: Rupees per US dollar, India consumer prices and India short-term interest rates.

datasets.name: Cboe VIX volatility index history
datasets.license: Free download from Cboe; check Cboe terms before redistributing.
datasets.description: Daily open, high, low and close of the VIX since 1990, the market's main fear gauge.

datasets.name: Fama-French factors and momentum
datasets.license: Free for research; cite the Kenneth French Data Library.
datasets.description: Monthly US market excess return, size (SMB), value (HML), risk-free rate and momentum factor returns since 1926.

datasets.name: Shiller US stock market data (CAPE)
datasets.license: Free for research; cite Robert Shiller.
datasets.description: Monthly S&P composite price, dividends, earnings, CPI, 10-year yield and the cyclically adjusted P/E (CAPE) since 1871.

datasets.name: Survey of Professional Forecasters (median forecasts)
datasets.license: Public data; cite the Philadelphia Fed.
datasets.description: Quarterly median forecasts since 1968 for unemployment, inflation, T-bill and T-bond yields. Compare what forecasters expected with what happened.

sheets.UNEMP: SPF median forecast: US unemployment rate
sheets.CPI: SPF median forecast: US CPI inflation
sheets.CORECPI: SPF median forecast: US core CPI inflation

datasets.name: FOMC policy statements
datasets.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
datasets.description: Full text of each Federal Open Market Committee statement linked from the Fed's meeting calendar (about the last five years).

datasets.name: Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letters
datasets.license: Freely published by Berkshire; for internal research use, not redistribution.
datasets.description: Warren Buffett's annual letters, 2000 onward: a long, dated record of a senior investor's market views and decisions.

datasets.name: World Bank: growth, inflation, jobs and external balance
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; cite the World Bank.
datasets.description: Annual GDP growth, CPI inflation, unemployment and current account balance for India, US, China, Japan, Germany, UK, Brazil and the euro area since 1990.

datasets.name: SEC 13F holdings: Fisher Investments and Berkshire Hathaway
datasets.license: US government data, public domain. The SEC requires a User-Agent with your name and email.
datasets.description: The last four quarterly 13F-HR holdings reports for each manager, with quarter-over-quarter buys, sells, new positions and exits.

datasets.name: Your own documents (Universe/my-docs)
datasets.license: Whatever applies to the files you add. Keep client data out unless it is anonymised.
datasets.description: Drop .pdf, .txt, .md, .html or .csv files into Universe/my-docs (for example bank outlooks you saved, or anonymised house-view notes), then click Scan. Start a file name with a date like 2024-03-15 to date it.
